tagline: Get your hands on fresh fruit and veggies at local farms and gardens
description: Feedback from a visitor, June 09, 2010: " is an berry farm in Arrow, OK. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Corn, and Asparagus, best in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
